title: add vpc control plane terraform: multi-az interface endpoints, sgs, peering, route53
author: Asha Patel
description: Add Terraform modules and orchestration to provision the VPC private control plane for multi-AZ deployments. This PR implements subnet layout for 3 AZs, interface and gateway endpoints for required AWS services, security group rules scoped to control-plane traffic, cross-account VPC peering and Route53 private hosted zone delegation to support service discovery. Motivation: enable Private deployments (VPC mode) to be provisioned by customers with a repeatable, auditable Terraform module that matches Redwood's production topology and security posture. Changes include: new module 'control-plane-vpc', variable-driven AZ/subnet sizing, optional interface endpoints (S3, ECR, KMS, EC2, STS), managed security groups with least-privilege ingress, cross-account peering templates and route propagation, Route53 delegated zones and resolver rules, and tests + examples. Checklist: - [x] Terraform module with README and usage examples. - [x] Integration test harness (+ mocked AWS responses) for create/destroy. - [x] Upgrade hooks to safely migrate existing single-AZ stacks to multi-AZ. - [x] RBAC notes for private installer. - [x] Documentation update under docs/private/vpc.md. Follow-ups: add module parameter for interface endpoint policies and automated peering acceptance for multi-account flows (ENG-4821).

release_notes: Terraform: add control-plane-vpc module to provision multi-AZ VPC control plane with interface endpoints, security groups, peering, and Route53 delegation. Includes upgrade hooks and examples.
deployment_instructions: Run 'terraform init' then 'terraform plan -var-file=examples/multi-az/vars.tfvars' in examples/multi-az to validate. For production apply, follow docs/private/vpc.md: set auto_accept_peering=false for cross-account peering flows and perform peering acceptance in the accepting account. Ensure Route53 delegation accounts have correct IAM principals.
test_summary: New CI job 'tf-integration-control-plane' runs packer-mocked terraform plan/apply with the integration harness. All tests passed after fixes. Acceptance tests validate subnet counts, endpoint creation, security group rules, peering route propagation, and Route53 delegation records.
risk_assessment: Low-medium. Module is opt-in and behind examples; defaults favor explicit peering acceptance. Migration path added for single-AZ stacks but customers must follow the upgrade checklist. Security review completed (SEC-57).
notes: This PR is part of the Private deployment automation effort to make control-plane provisioning first-class for enterprise customers. Follow-up PR will add automated acceptance workflows for cross-account peering and optional endpoint policies.
